data.narrative:
Constellr is a Series A-stage space and aerospace company founded by Max Gulde and Marius Bierdel that has raised €37M to date. The valuation assessment draws on a comp universe of 5 public tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers spanning the sector, including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Two valuation methods prove applicable. Stage-progression analysis anchors to the €37M total raised as a proxy for current value and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage progression, yielding €74M. Peer-median triangulation identifies 3 comparable companies at same or adjacent stage (Cowboy Space Corporation at Series B valued at $2.0B; Aalyria at Series B at $1.3B; Starcloud at Seed at $1.1B), producing a median valuation of $1.3B with a range of $1.1B–$2.0B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied; while the Space & Aerospace sector trades at a 25.3x P/S median across 6 public names, Constellr's revenue remains undisclosed.

The triangulated range spans $63M (floor, stage-progression) to $1.5B (ceiling, peer high), with a median of $687M across the two methods. Key uncertainties include whether peers' valuations reflect comparable revenue traction and unit economics, and whether Constellr's technology differentiation justifies positioning toward the peer median or range extremes.
